body.purpose: Collaboration copy and controls; inputs use 16px.

brand.purpose: Existing collaboration sidebar wordmark; authentication uses 48px Georgia.

motion.name: reduced-motion-scroll
motion.purpose: Collaboration descendants disable smooth scrolling under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.description: Primary form action with explicit disabled state.
components.name: Collaboration primary button
components.css: .evergreen-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; padding:9px 14px; border:1px solid var(--emerald); border-radius:8px; background:var(--emerald); color:#04150f; font:650 14px/1.5 Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .evergreen-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#36e7ac; color:#04150f; } .evergreen-primary:focus-visible { outline:1px solid rgba(8,229,154,.75); outline-offset:1px; } .evergreen-primary:disabled { background:#1b3026; border-color:#354d40; color:#b4c4bb; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Collaboration field
components.description: Visible field label, dark background and inherited global keyboard focus.
components.css: .evergreen-label { display:grid; gap:7px; margin:12px 0; color:var(--soft); font:14px/1.5 Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .evergreen-field { width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid #35423d; border-radius:8px; background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); font:16px Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .evergreen-field::placeholder { color:#9ba9a2; } .evergreen-field:focus-visible { outline:1px solid rgba(8,229,154,.75); outline-offset:1px; }

dos: Sinalizar recurso não configurado ou indisponível.
narrative.overview: Extensão da interface Evergreen existente: superfícies escuras, divisórias discretas, esmeralda nas ações e marca serifada. Colaboração usa listas planas, histórico e composer, com menu lateral e navegação inferior em telas pequenas.
donts: Não usar toast fictício, presença inventada ou contador de notificações fictício.
Não usar identidade local para autorização remota.
